products.name: CBS Accelerator (N-Cyclohexyl-2-benzothiazolesulfenamide)
products.description: Primary sulfenamide accelerator for natural and synthetic rubber. Provides delayed action and excellent scorch safety in general-purpose compounds.

products.name: MBTS Accelerator (Dibenzothiazyl Disulfide)
products.description: Thiazole-type secondary accelerator. Widely used in tire treads, mechanical goods, and extruded profiles. Good processing safety.

products.name: TMTD Accelerator (Tetramethylthiuram Disulfide)
products.description: Thiuram-class ultra-accelerator and sulfur donor. Used in low-sulfur or sulfurless vulcanization systems. Effective in latex and dry rubber.

products.name: 6PPD Antioxidant (N-(1,3-Dimethylbutyl)-N'-phenyl-p-phenylenediamine)
products.description: Para-phenylenediamine antidegradant. Superior protection against ozone, flex cracking, and heat aging in tire sidewalls and mechanical goods.

products.name: TMQ Antioxidant (Polymerized 2,2,4-Trimethyl-1,2-Dihydroquinoline)
products.description: Amine-type antioxidant offering long-term thermal and oxidative aging protection. Used in tires, conveyor belts, and hose applications.

products.name: Naphthenic Process Oil
products.description: 200L drum. Medium viscosity naphthenic oil for rubber processing. Improves filler dispersion, reduces mixing viscosity, and enhances low-temperature flexibility.

products.name: Zinc Oxide USP Grade (French Process)
products.description: 25 kg bag. High-purity zinc oxide activator for rubber vulcanization. French process grade with >99.5% ZnO content and low lead content.

products.name: Stearic Acid (Rubber Grade)
products.description: 25 kg bag. Fatty acid activator used with zinc oxide in vulcanization. Also functions as internal lubricant and processing aid.

products.name: Carbon Black N330 (HAF Grade)
products.description: 25 kg bag. High Abrasion Furnace carbon black. Primary reinforcing filler for tire treads, belts, and mechanical rubber goods.

products.name: PVI Peptizer (N-(Cyclohexylthio)phthalimide)
products.description: Prevulcanization inhibitor and scorch retarder for natural rubber. Extends processing safety without affecting cure rate or physical properties.

products.name: OBSH Blowing Agent (4,4'-Oxybis(benzenesulfonyl hydrazide))
products.description: Endothermic/exothermic blowing agent for closed-cell rubber sponge and foam applications. Decomposes at 150-160°C releasing nitrogen gas.

products.name: EPDM Polymer (Vistalon 7001, ExxonMobil)
products.description: Ethylene-propylene-diene terpolymer. High ethylene content for outstanding weather resistance, ozone resistance, and heat aging in automotive seals and roofing membranes.
